# Tyler White

> Tyler White is a Director of Product Design based in Montreal with 16 years in product design, and the creator of the Builder Kickoff™. He writes about how product designers scope the right problem, build the business case for design, and prove what design is worth: PRDs, kickoffs, case studies, UX metrics and AI workflows for designers.

## Letters

- [Scope Creep in Product Design: How to Handle It (Scripts)](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/scope-creep/): How to handle scope creep in product design mid-project: the swap rule, word-for-word scripts for stakeholders, and a change log that protects the deadline.
- [ROI of Design: How to Actually Calculate It](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/roi-of-design/): Calculate the ROI of design for a real feature: the formula, worked examples for revenue, retention and cost, and a free calculator to run your own.
- [What Is a PRD? Meaning and What Goes in One](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/what-is-a-prd/): PRD stands for product requirements document: the doc that says what a team is building, why, and how they'll know it worked. Here's what goes in one.
- [Product Designer Salary 2026: US and Canada Ranges](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/product-designer-salary/): What product designers earn in 2026 in the US and Canada, by level and company, and the skills that move you from mid-level pay to senior pay.
- [PRD Template I Actually Use (Free, Copy-Paste)](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/prd-template/): A free PRD template to copy and paste, plus how to fill it from one kickoff meeting so engineering gets a doc they'll actually read. Example included.
- [Design Rationale: Explaining Design Decisions](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/design-rationale/): How to write and present design rationale: which calls aren't up for debate, how to document the ones that are, and a decision record format to reuse.
- [UX Case Study Examples That Prove Impact](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/ux-case-study-examples/): What strong UX case study examples have in common: a structure built around decisions, results placed where they land, and a slide about what went wrong.
- [UX Case Study Template Built Around Decisions](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/ux-case-study-template/): A free UX case study template structured around decisions and outcomes, plus five questions that pressure-test the story before your next portfolio review.
- [Product Designer Portfolio Homepage That Sells](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/product-designer-portfolio/): How to structure a product designer portfolio homepage: a one-line hero, a proof strip, case studies sorted by outcome and result-first headlines.
- [Project Kickoff Meeting Agenda and Template](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/project-kickoff-meeting/): A project kickoff meeting agenda that forces real decisions in 60 minutes: the four questions to ask, who should be in the room, and what you leave with.
- [Product Brief and Design Brief Template](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/product-brief-template/): A free product brief template plus the design brief questions that matter, so design gets pulled in before the decisions are made, not after.
- [Cursor for Designers: Why I Left Figma Make](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/cursor-for-designers/): Why I switched from Figma Make to Cursor for real product prototypes: the credit burn, the spec-driven loop that replaced it, and when Figma still wins.
- [PRD vs BRD: Key Differences and Which You Need](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/prd-vs-brd/): A BRD explains why the business wants it. A PRD explains what the product will do. See the differences side by side, and which one your team needs.
- [UX Metrics That Make It Into the Exec Deck](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/ux-metrics/): The UX metrics and KPIs leadership cares about: adoption, retention, efficiency and revenue, plus how to estimate impact without perfect data.
- [AI Prototyping Workflow for Product Designers](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/ai-prototyping-workflow/): A real AI prototyping workflow for product designers: load context, explore 4-5 directions to kill bad ideas fast, test in code, then polish. Prompt included.
- [All Letters](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/letters/): The full archive.

## Products and free resources

- [Builder Kickoff™ Course](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/builder-kickoff/): A 20-minute recorded course on running the session that turns a business problem into a scoped decision, then a PRD and a prototype prompt.
- [The 15 Minute Case Study](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/roi-case-study-template/): A free Claude skill that turns rough project notes into a case study.
- [The Funnel Simulator](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/funnel-simulator/): A free Claude skill that builds a funnel simulator for a SaaS product.
- [The ROI of Design Newsletter](https://www.mrtylerwhite.com/newsletter/): A weekly newsletter on scoping, framing and building the business case for design work.
